about: The YPCB-00338's PCIe core: LitePCIe (Gen2 x8, 128 bits at 250 MHz) on the 7 Series Integrated Block (the pcie_7x IP pcie_s7.tcl creates, driven by LitePCIe's S7PCIEPHY with its own pipe clock MMCM), LitePCIe's endpoint (16 read requests in flight), its scatter-gather DMA (tables 256 deep, prog mode), MSI, BAR0 (1 MiB: the user window 0-0x7FFFF to an AXI-Lite master, LiteX's CSRs above) and openTPU's otpu_dma (command queues, completion counters and record), generated by tools/litepcie/gen_core.py (docs/litepcie.md); its csr.csv is opentpu/host/litepcie/, its csr.h the driver's (opentpu/host/pcie/otpu). Check or regenerate: tools/litepcie/check_core.sh.
